caption:
Food prices jumped 0.5% in October. 🛒
That's the biggest monthly rise since April, per the BLS data reported by Fox Business. Gas rose 1% on top of it, and overall prices were up 0.4% for the month.
The government didn't publish a yearly rate this time because of last year's shutdown gap.
Which bill felt the biggest jump for you this fall?
